# Forgejo GitHub Theme 1.3.0 - The remaining pages, and what Forgejo 17 lost

The pages that still looked like Forgejo now follow GitHub, including releases on GitHub's new sidebar layout. Features
the template overrides had dropped against Forgejo 17 are back, and a team's members are private again.

# Compatibility

This release targets Forgejo `17`. It was tested against Forgejo `17.0.0`, including the bundled template overrides.

Install the stylesheets and templates together, as with 1.2.0. Update the templates soon: since the templates of 0.3.0,
any member of an organization could see who belongs to each of its teams. Forgejo shows a team's members only to its own
members and the organization's owners, and the templates of 1.3.0 do so again.
